meta.title: Global Flood Cause Evolution

direct_runoff_volume.label: Direct stormflow volume of the selected events
direct_runoff_volume.meaning: The event-scale direct runoff volume associated with the selected large floods.

flood_peak.label: Maximum daily streamflow during the selected events
flood_peak.meaning: The largest daily streamflow observed inside each reconstructed event-response window.

exceedance_frequency.label: Annual frequency of events above the fixed Q95 volume threshold
exceedance_frequency.meaning: How many selected large floods occurred per observed year.

mechanism_frequency.label: Annual frequency of the selected flood-generating process
mechanism_frequency.meaning: How often this process produced a Q95 large flood in the catchment.

mechanism_share.label: Share of selected floods generated by this process
mechanism_share.meaning: How this process's percentage of the catchment's selected large floods changed.

rainfall_concentration.label: Share of event rainfall falling on its rainiest day
rainfall_concentration.meaning: Rainfall concentration is the percentage of total event rainfall falling on the single rainiest day.

antecedent_wetness.label: Soil saturation index before the selected flood events
antecedent_wetness.meaning: The normalized 0–1 soil saturation state preceding the selected events.

mechanisms.label: Dry + Intensity
mechanisms.meaning: Peaked rainfall over initially dry soil

mechanisms.label: Dry + Volume
mechanisms.meaning: Prolonged or distributed rainfall over initially dry soil

mechanisms.label: Moderate + Intensity
mechanisms.meaning: Peaked rainfall over moderately wet soil

mechanisms.label: Moderate + Volume
mechanisms.meaning: Prolonged or distributed rainfall over moderately wet soil

mechanisms.label: Wet + Volume
mechanisms.meaning: Prolonged or distributed rainfall over wet soil

meta.conditionSource: All selected POT/Q95 floods; annual event means; Theil–Sen slope and Mann–Kendall test. Source: primary_extreme_events.parquet.
